Instead of opening the correct page (which should have been `https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0720297/`), it loaded the profile for a different actor, Michael Wincott (`https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0000699/`). This is a critical navigation error where the agent executed the instruction to "open the correct IMDb page" but retrieved data for the wrong entity entirely, leading to a complete failure to gather the required birthplace information for the correct director.
